items.name: heading-a
items.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a polished Japanese manga landing-page SECTION HEADING DESIGN PROPOSAL, not a whole page and not a mobile device mockup. Wide landscape 1536x1024 image. Palette must remain deep navy blue, champagne gold, white. Strict exact heading in 2 lines, same font size both lines, modern bold Japanese webfont appearance: 「こんなお悩み」 then 「ありませんか？」. First line white, second champagne gold. Comfortable generous padding. The rectangle has an inset gold double frame, and a prominent centered downward NAVY triangular speech-tail with BOTH gold frame lines following its contour. The triangle must connect beautifully with the rectangular frame, not floating and not gold/red fill. Behind lower portion: cropped full-width warm illustrated salon scene (around bottom 40% of image) with the same adult woman Mari as reference, golden wavy long hair, amber eyes, pearl earrings, black blazer over white blouse. Her worried face looking at a phone and desk; no speech bubbles, no additional words in comic. Top 60% is heading plus triangle. Manga edge consistent black-white-black fine frame. No A/B labels, no extra title, no red, no fake statistics. Preserve refined existing comic character identity. Variant A: classic integrated double-line rectangle speech balloon. A single broad navy rectangular heading block, fine straight gold outer and inner frame with subtly clipped corners. At center bottom both gold outlines follow a 100px-wide downward triangular tail seamlessly. Navy tail directly overlays the manga. A restrained editorial gold finish, very clear continuous outline.
items.repairPrompt: Refine this EXACT Japanese LP heading design. Keep every pixel concept, text, character, framing, colors, layout and proportions the same. Only repair the inner thin gold outline at the central navy downward triangle: currently the thin inner rectangular gold outline stops at both sides before the triangle. Extend that inner thin gold line diagonally down along BOTH sides of the triangle and connect into a V, parallel to and inset from the existing outer thick gold triangular outline. Both gold frame contours must run continuously around rectangle AND triangle. The navy fill remains inside triangle. Do not add words or redraw character. Exact text unchanged こんなお悩み / ありませんか？. Output same landscape1536x1024.

items.name: closing-a
items.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create ONE polished long Japanese smartphone LP lower-section design proposal, 1024x3072 portrait aspect1:3, naturally extending well beyond one smartphone screen. Never compress into one screen. Premium navy blue and champagne gold visual design with warm golden manga illustrations, high-quality commercial manga, no copyrighted style. Same recurring characters as references: Mari adult woman golden blonde wavy long hair, amber eyes, pearl earrings, black blazer white blouse; Saito adult man black wavy parted hair, navy suit white open collar. Spacious hierarchy, large readable Japanese typography, generous vertical gaps. This is the important closing explanation after Google ads. CONTENT in order: headline 2 lines 「探している人に、」「お店の魅力が届くように。」; short subcopy「広告からLP、LINEまで。予約へつながる流れを整えます。」; FOUR clearly separated illustrated stages with exact short captions: 01「エリア・言語・検索内容を合わせる」 02「広告に合った言語のLPへ」 03「魅力と、選ばれる理由を伝える」 04「LINEで質問から予約受付へ」. Every stage must have a meaningful distinct illustration, not just a number or icon. In stage1 show customers looking for nearby salon with simple search/pin symbolic graphics, not an imitation Google screenshot. Stage2 show Japanese,English,Thai page choices with labels「日本語」「English」「ไทย」and smartphone. Stage3 show customer evaluating salon service/price with Saito guiding. Stage4 show LINE conversation phone and calendar. These are illustrative visual concepts, NOT actual search/map UI: no fake Google screens, no invented company reviews or results, no invented prices. Then emotional manga of Mari helping a customer, text bubble「返信に追われず、お客様に集中できそう！」; offer bridge at end exact「この流れを、お店に合わせて整えるのが」「バンコク店舗集客セットです。」No CTA button here, no extra author name labels. Clear explanatory content, no crammed text. Variant A: cinematic vertical story flow. Navy canvas, a glowing but refined gold route line running down left, large 01-04 medallions connected. Each step is a full-width staggered illustration scene alternating image/text alignment, separated with quiet navy breathing space. Four illustrations have ample height. End with large Mari customer scene and then bold centered gold offer text on navy. About55% illustrations45% typography.
